finalText:
**380 commits, 37 matter.** 114 were dep bumps. Draft is in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

Three breaking items you may not have known about. Internal error types stopped being re-exported from five modules. The v1 export route was deleted. An expired token now returns `401`, not `403`.

One feature. Webhook retries with exponential backoff.

The latency histogram unit fix changes recorded values. Dashboards need rescaling. Call it out in the announcement, not just the notes.

Two things to check before you cut. Does `package.json` `engines` actually move? Six `docs: note the minimum node version` commits and a CI switch to node 22 hint at it. And confirm the v1 export route had no external users.
